newsitem.title: USA: One dead in West Virginia bridge collapse.
newsitem.headline: One dead in West Virginia bridge collapse.

text.p: A construction worker was killed and three were injured when a bridge under constructon in Wayne County, West Virginia, collapsed Wednesday, emergency officials said.
A spokeswoman for the West Virginia state police said parts of the bridge were being replaced when the accident occurred. No information was available on the dead worker.
"Our officers are there now, trying to determine what happened," she said.
There was no traffic on the bridge at the time of the accident. The bridge crosses the Big Sandy river and connects West Virginia and Kentucky.
